p4_b6.ocr: Additionally, the table illustrates the differential effects of various musical stimuli, such as Baroque music and Heavy metal music, on recovery metrics following the exposure. These findings underscore the significance of auditory environments in modulating chemical toxicity and recovery, offering a nuanced perspective on the interplay between environmental factors and biochemical responses. Such insights are crucial for developing more effective strategies in toxicology and environmental health.
